# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Opens the 3.119.5 servicing line**

## Highlights

Backports the Apple 26.0 unversioned TFMs and a WinUI Projection DLL fix to the v3 line. This preview backports the .NET 9 WinUI packaging fix and the Apple unversioned app TFM support already shipped on v4, alongside CI stability work.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL restored for .NET 9** — Fixes a missing WinUI Projection DLL that broke .NET 9 consumers referencing SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs backported** — Brings the Apple 26.0 native library and unversioned application target framework monikers to the v3 servicing line. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
